name: web-coral-streetwear-store-hero-with-cut-out-model-over-headline
title: Coral Streetwear Hero with Model over Headline
whatItIs: A rounded website card over blurred pink screens: a nav, a headline 'Own the EDGE Keep the VIBE' set around a cut-out model in a beanie and printed hoodie who overlaps the coral hero panel, with a New Drops button, rating chips, feature icons and a featured product card.
whatItMeans: The model breaking out of the coral panel and splitting the headline creates depth and attitude, and coral feels youthful.
techniques: Cut-out model overlapping the headline and panel
Italic script words alongside heavy display words
Featured product card with a price pill
bestFor: Hero sections with a cut-out figure

vocabulary.definition: A subject overlapping the boundary of its container.
Heavy display type paired with italic light words.
A small card highlighting one product.
